environment.description: Celery worker running as celery user (uid 1000) on Ubuntu 22.04 host. Worker process has standard filesystem access. Log files at /var/log/worker/ are consumed by Filebeat which ships to Elasticsearch/Kibana SIEM. The headers.log file is also parsed by an nginx-based log replay proxy that re-emits entries as HTTP headers for a legacy monitoring system. The worker runs with standard process isolation (systemd unit, no additional confinement).

config.filesystem: standard ext4, worker has write to /var/log/worker and /var/reports
config.log_consumer: Filebeat -> Elasticsearch, nginx log-replay proxy parses headers.log
config.network: Worker has outbound internet access for callback verification
